ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 cargo_var varchar2(100);
 tran_var varchar2(100);
 dt varchar(300);
 grp varchar2(1000);
 ctg varchar2(3000);
 trn varchar2 (2000);
port_val varchar2(2000);
TIM VARCHAR2(300);
P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :PORT IS NULL THEN 
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PORT;
 END IF;

SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_NBR
FROM 
VSSL_CNTNRS,
VSSL_BL_ITEMS,
SEA_DLVY_ITEMS,
DCLTN_GATE_TRANS, 
DECLARATIONS, 
DCLTN_TYPES, 
IMPORTERS,
VHCL_TRANSACTIONS, 
VHCL_DRIVERS, 
VHCL_OWNERS

WHERE VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD = VSSL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD
AND VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE
AND VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR
AND VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT = VSSL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT
AND VSSL_BL_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ = VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ

AND SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.PORT_CD
AND SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE
AND SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_NBR = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_NBR
AND SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_DT = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.MFST_DT
AND SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.BL_SEQ = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.BL_SEQ
AND SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ = VSSL_BL_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ


AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_NBR
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ = SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ

AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN_TYPES.TYPE_ID

AND DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = IMPORTERS.PORT_CD
AND DECLARATIONS.IMPR_NBR = IMPORTERS.IMPR_NBR

AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN

AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD = VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.PORT_CD
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.TRAN_SEQ
AND DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.TRANS_DATE_H

AND VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.DRIVER_CTRY_CD = VHCL_DRIVERS.CTRY_CD (+)
AND VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.PSPRT_NO = VHCL_DRIVERS.PSPRT_NO (+)
AND VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE = VHCL_DRIVERS.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE (+)

AND VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.PORT_CD = VHCL_OWNERS.PORT_CD (+)
AND VHCL_TRANSACTIONS.OWNER_SEQ = VHCL_OWNERS.OWNER_SEQ (+)

AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)

AND VSSL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_MRK = :P_CNTNR_MRK);

 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CNTNR_MRK',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_CNTNR_MRK);
 
 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'to_d_h',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'st_year_fin',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FINANCE_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
 else
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 
END ;
